posts.zh:
dsh-selection-followup 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。选中聊天回复中的任意文字，浮出「追问/复制」气泡：一键把选中内容作为引用填入输入框（问题由你输入），或一键复制。另附安装与实现文档。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-81087cbdace86432797e.html
posts.en:
dsh-selection-followup is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Select any text in a DSH chat reply to get a floating Follow-up/Copy pill: one click quotes the selection into the composer so you can type your own follow-up question, or copies it.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-81087cbdace86432797e.html
